question: What topics conclude the examination of the descent of power?
premises: The establishment of independence is treated.
The variety of concealment is treated.
These form the summary of topics in the examination of the descent of power.
inference: The examination of śaktipāta culminates in independence and the diverse modes of concealment.
uncertainties: anapekṣitva may refer to the independence of grace or of the liberated state.
plain_english: The establishment of independence and the variety of concealment complete the summary of topics in the examination of the descent of power.
